evolution_req.special: Complete "The Convergence of Elder Realm and Myth Eternal" story quest

star_8.name: Ancient Titan: World-Shaper
star_8.appearance: The World-Soul form exists beyond biological categorization. Ancient Titan at this tier does not occupy a location — it defines one. Scholars disagree on whether it is still a creature or has become something closer to a natural law.
star_8.personality: Beyond personality as a concept. It operates on geological timescales. What feels like indifference is actually patience measured in centuries.
star_8.lore: The World-Soul form of Ancient Titan has never been fully documented. The three known individuals in history caused reality-scale events: a tectonic shift, the permanent darkening of a sky, and the spontaneous formation of an entire new ecosystem. Their tamers were never the same afterward.
star_8.passive: Ancient Ward — reduces incoming magical damage by 15%

base_chain.name: Pup Ancient Titan
base_chain.appearance: A small, delicate form of Ancient Titan. Its body is simple — barely touched by the Primal element — but its eyes already carry an ancient awareness far beyond its size.
base_chain.personality: Curious and gentle. Startles easily. Bonds with the first being that offers it warmth or food without aggression.
base_chain.lore: The earliest stage of Ancient Titan is found only in the most sheltered corners of Elder Realm × Myth Eternal. Hatchlings travel in loose clusters, communicating through shared elemental pulses tamers describe as 'warm static.' Finding one is considered a blessing.
base_chain.passive: Obsidian Skin — first hit each battle is negated entirely

base_chain.name: Stirring Ancient Titan
base_chain.appearance: The Primal element begins to manifest: faint glowing sigils trace along its hide, and it moves with deliberate intent. Its form has grown noticeably, and other creatures instinctively give it space.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests its limits constantly. Shows flashes of the dominant personality it will develop.
base_chain.lore: Awakened Ancient Titans begin staking small territory within Elder Realm × Myth Eternal. Other creatures learn the boundary markers they leave — elemental traces burned or carved into surfaces — and respect them. Tamers in this stage gain a creature beginning to choose its own path.
base_chain.passive: Eternity Mark — gains +1% to all stats permanently on each kill

base_chain.name: Ancient Titan
base_chain.appearance: The Champion form — the creature as the world knows it. Every feature reflects its Elder Realm × Myth Eternal origin: the palette, the silhouette, the elemental signature of Primal radiating freely. Battle-tested and undeniable.
base_chain.personality: Settled and purposeful. Protective of its tamer. Has developed clear preferences and dislikes.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is what scholars study, what the Codex depicts, and what hunters fear. In Elder Realm × Myth Eternal, Champion-class Ancient Titans are given wide berths by travelers. A tamer who commands one has earned a reputation that precedes them in every guild hall.
base_chain.passive: World Resonance — at ★8, all stats increase by 50% in own realm

base_chain.name: Forsaken Ancient Titan
base_chain.appearance: At the Exalted threshold, the creature restructures. Elder Realm × Myth Eternal-specific motifs deepen dramatically. The path chosen — Convergent — begins to reshape its silhouette, and a visible aura of power surrounds it at all times.
base_chain.personality: The personality aligns sharply with the Convergent path. Focused, deliberate, and quietly formidable. Other creatures of lower tiers instinctively defer to it.
base_chain.lore: Few ever reach Exalted status. Elder Realm × Myth Eternal records fewer than a thousand confirmed sightings across its history. Tamers with Exalted companions are granted special dispensations in every realm's settlement — the right to skip queues, enter restricted areas, and request audiences with the powerful.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Echo — 20% chance to reflect debuffs back on attacker

fusion_lore: A creature that predates both the sea and story. It is what both realms were before they had names.
